paper_title: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
suggested_experiment_name: UPLOAD-CMC-II-RT (UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection - Copper Microwave Cavity II, Room Temperature)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis (natural units)
notes: This is an erratum/corrected version of the original UPLOAD-CMC paper. The paper reports measured exclusion limits (not projections) from a room-temperature cylindrical microwave cavity haloscope experiment using dual-mode oscillators. Two distinct mass ranges are constrained: (1) upconversion range 7.44–19.38 neV excluding g_agamma > 3×10^-3 1/GeV, and (2) downconversion range 74.4–74.5 μeV excluding g_agamma > 10^-2 1/GeV. The erratum corrects a sign error in the sensitivity calculation that reduced low-mass sensitivity by four orders of magnitude and increased high-mass sensitivity by up to 11 orders of magnitude relative to the original submission. The experiment assumes a standard galactic halo dark matter density of ρ_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm³ (8×10^-22 kg/m³) with Maxwell-Boltzmann velocity distribution (v_c = 225 km/s). Data points are encoded as horizontal lines spanning the stated mass ranges per the mass-independent bound convention.
